name: Orgain Organic Plant-Based Protein Powder (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Combines raw pea protein, brown rice, chia seeds, erythritol (sugar alcohol), and thick acacia/guar gums. Creates high osmotic draw and intense microbial gas fermentation in the large intestine.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Exercise caution if prone to gas and distention. Switch to hydrolyzed collagen or pure egg white protein isolate instead.
